# Party reference

The party component, the party it joins and the rules that decide who shares a kill. For how to use it, see [Party](../modules/party.md).

## VtUnitParty

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Party → VtUnitParty**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

A unit's membership in a `VtParty`: invites, joining, leaving, and the leader's kick, promote and loot rule. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useParty`; `VtUnit` attaches it.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit Unit { get; }` | The unit this component belongs to. |
| `VtParty Party { get; }` | The party this unit is in, or null. |
| `bool InParty { get; }` | True while in a party. |
| `bool IsLeader { get; }` | True when this unit leads its party. |
| `VtUnit PendingInviter { get; }` | The unit whose invite is waiting for an answer, or null. |
| `static int MaxSize { get; }` | Most members a party may have, from the tuning asset. |
| `event Action<VtParty> OnPartyChanged` | Fires on every member when the party formed, changed or disbanded. Null means no party. |
| `event Action<VtUnit> OnInvited` | Fires on the invited unit with the inviter. |
| `event Action OnInviteCleared` | Fires when a pending invite was accepted, declined or dropped. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the sibling unit. Safe to call more than once; call it after adding the component at runtime. |
| `static bool AreInSameParty(VtUnit a, VtUnit b)` | True when `a` and `b` are the same unit or members of one party. |
| `bool CanInvite(VtUnit target, out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Whether this unit could invite `target` now. Pure query. |
| `bool Invite(VtUnit target, out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Invite `target`. A newer invite replaces an older one on the target. |
| `bool AcceptInvite(out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Join the inviter's party, forming it if the inviter had none. |
| `bool DeclineInvite()` | Turn down the pending invite. False when there is none. |
| `bool Leave()` | Leave the party. The next member leads if the leader leaves; a party of one disbands. |
| `bool Kick(VtUnit member, out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Remove `member` from the party. Leader only. |
| `bool Promote(VtUnit member, out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Hand leadership to `member`. Leader only. |
| `bool SetLootRule(VtPartyLootRule rule, out VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Change who may pick up the party's drops. Leader only. |
| `void ApplyPartyFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> members, VtUnit leader, VtPartyLootRule rule)` | Replace this unit's view of its party. Used by replication; not authority-gated. An empty list means no party. |
| `void ApplyInviteFromNet(VtUnit inviter)` | Replace this unit's pending invite. Used by replication; not authority-gated. Null clears it. |

## VtParty

Class.

A group of units that share kill credit, loot and party-only effects. Read-only to consumers: every change goes through the members' `VtUnitParty` components so it is authority-gated and raises events. Destroyed members drop out on the next read.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit Leader { get; }` | The member who may invite, kick, promote and change the loot rule. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> Members { get; }` | Every member, leader included, in join order. |
| `int Count { get; }` | Number of members. |
| `VtPartyLootRule LootRule { get; }` | Who may pick up drops from the party's kills. |
| `bool Contains(VtUnit unit)` | True when `unit` is a member. |

## VtPartyRules

Static class.

Who shares a kill. XP awards, currency drops and kill objectives ask here, so a custom reward system can apply the same rules.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static void GetCreditRecipients(VtUnit killer, Vector3 at, List<VtUnit> results)` | Fill `results` with the killer first, then every other member of the killer's party within `VtTuning.partyShareRange` of `at`. A solo killer is the only recipient. |
| `static bool IsInShareRange(VtUnit unit, Vector3 at)` | True when `unit` stands within the share range of `at` on the ground plane. A range of 0 means any distance. |
| `static bool SharesKillCredit(VtUnit holder, VtUnitId killerId, VtUnit killed)` | True when a kill by `killerId` also counts for `holder`: a different unit in the holder's party, with the holder in share range of the killed unit. |
| `static int SplitXp(int award, int recipients)` | XP each of `recipients` gets from an award of `award`: the award plus `VtTuning.partyXpBonusPerMember` per extra recipient, split evenly, at least 1. |

## Enums

### VtPartyFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitParty` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `InvalidTarget` | No target, the unit itself, a unit without a party component, a hostile unit, or someone not in this party. |
| `TargetInParty` | The invited unit already belongs to a party. |
| `AlreadyInParty` | This unit already belongs to a party. |
| `NotInParty` | This unit belongs to no party. |
| `NotLeader` | Only the leader may do this. |
| `PartyFull` | The party has `VtTuning.partyMaxSize` members. |
| `NoInvite` | No invite is pending, or the inviter is gone. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtPartyLootRule

Who may pick up items that drop from a kill made by a party member. Serialized as int; append-only.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `FreeForAll` | Anyone may pick up the drop. |
| `PartyReserved` | For `VtTuning.lootReserveSeconds` only the killer's party may pick up the drop; after that anyone may. |
